identificationModule.briefTitle: Cabergoline Versus Calcium Infusion in Ovarian Hyperstimulation Syndrome Prevention
identificationModule.officialTitle: Comparison of Cabergoline Versus Calcium Infusion in Ovarian Hyperstimulation Syndrome Prevention:Randomized Controlled Trial

descriptionModule.briefSummary: Giving oral Cabergoline or calcium infusion in women at high risk for developing ovarian hyperstimulation syndrome in context of assisted reproductive technologies aiming in its prevention
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: Women undergoing in vitro fertilization or intracytoplasmic sperm injection whom were at high risk for developing ovarian hyperstimuation syndrome were received either oral Cabergoline.5mg tablets for 7days starting on ovum pick up day and continued for 7days or received 10ml of 10%calcium gluconate in 200ml normal saline on ovum pick up day and continued for 4days

armGroups.label: Calcium infusion
armGroups.description: 10ml 10%calcium gluconate in 200ml normal saline solution given intravenously over thirty minutes, on ovum pick up day and continued for 4days

armGroups.label: Oral Cabergoline
armGroups.description: Receiving oral Cabergoline (cabergamon 0.5 milligram tablet ) from ovum pick up day and continued for 7days,once daily

interventions.name: Oral Cabergoline
interventions.description: Giving oral Cabergoline tablet 0.5 milligram daily starting on ovum pick up day and continued for seven days

interventions.name: Calcium Gluconate
interventions.description: Giving 10 ml of 10 % calcium gluconate on 200 ml normal saline solution o.9% intravenously over thirty minutes starting on ovum pick up day and continued for four days

primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: 20 days from ovum pick up day

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:

* women undergoing assisted reproductive technologies whom at high risk for developing ovarian hyperstimulation syndrome as with high basal antimullerian hormone ,excess antral follicular count ,high seum estradiol on day of humian choronic gonadotrophin

Exclusion Criteria:women with other endocrinopathy as congenital adrenal hyperplasia , hyperprolactinemia,diabetes
